block_readings.visual_reading: All73 marked centres are on the western seaward side or within the blue lagoon, except13613 at the bright southwestern inner reef margin. The72 water appearances include visible continuous blue lagoon surface around small subsurface-looking patches; no emerged structure or cloud covers those marked centres.13613 remains a reef-exposure/mixing question. Separate northern/southern clouds and the breaking-wave outer rim do not cover the water centres.

The34-centre group intersects a large southern cloud mass and its dark northwest shadow.31 exact centres retain cloud/edge/shadow visibility uncertainty, including labels6 near cloud gaps; only13624/13625/13628 are visibly in unobstructed marine-water context to its west. No hidden surface is guessed from surrounding ocean.
The single centre13648 lies in visible continuous wave-textured water, north of a nearby small shadow and southeast of a separate cloud cluster; neither covers its exact marked centre.
